name: Tonic
listed_description: Easy and efficient audio synthesis in C++.
reason: README says 'Fast and easy audio synthesis in C++' but gives no numbers. Wiki (Home, Guiding Principles, Fast Phasor, Road Map) only states the goal of being on par with or better than other portable synthesis libraries; the Road Map plans benchmarks against MomuSTK, Maximilian and libpd (mix 10 sine waves, chained FM) but reports none. Issue #3 'Create Performance Tests' is open with no results and no comments. Issues #91 and #163 are optimization tasks with no comparison. Web search found no third-party benchmark. Directional claim only.

name: Verovio
listed_description: Verovio is a fast and lightweight music notation engraving library.
reason: README calls it fast, portable and lightweight but has no timings and no comparison with LilyPond, MuseScore or any other engraver. Issue and pull-request searches (performance, faster, lilypond, musescore, x faster) show only before/after tuning of Verovio against itself (for example PR 3855 glyph lookup, PR 3893 regex construction, PR 4342 render performance), no numbers against a recognizable baseline. Project book, ISMIR 2014 paper and W3C mailing list posts were EGRESS_BLOCKED, so any numbers inside them could not be checked. Directional claim only.

name: Vireo
listed_description: A lightweight and versatile video processing library by Twitter.
reason: README says performance and memory were a strong focus and that trimming and remuxing are 'blazing fast even on mobile', with no numbers and no named baseline. Issue search found no speed comparisons with ffmpeg or libav; the repository has no benchmark directory (top level holds imagecore, imagetool, vireo, thirdparty; vireo/ has tests, tools, valgrind). The Twitter engineering announcement post (blog.x.com, blog.twitter.com) was EGRESS_BLOCKED and its search snippets carry no figures. Last commit 2021-10-21 (licence-header update). Directional claim only.
